sources.note: Routes queries between a thinking and a non-thinking model with a threshold that is adjusted online by a betting supermartingale, so the accumulated statistical evidence certifies at any stopping time that the accuracy given up stays under a user-specified tolerance.
sources.title: Anytime Safe PAC Efficient Reasoning

sources.note: UAT replaces the static confidence threshold in early-exit deep networks with a multi-armed bandit that adapts the threshold online and unsupervised, reporting 1.70-2.10x speedup at under 2% performance drop.
sources.title: Beyond Greedy Exits: Improved Early Exit Decisions for Risk Control and Reliability
